name: diamond
comment: The 1 one-sided diamond (1 free, 0 of them a mirror twin): unions of unit TRIANGLES on the triangular lattice; boundary corners 60°…300°. Generated by alphabets/gen_polyform_palette.py triangle 2; every tile is the `polyomino` kind, which is just a cyclic interior-angle word, so the lattice never reaches the search. Chirality is DISTINGUISHED (X ≠ X'), the shelf convention and a deliberate departure from the A068599 mirror-merge one. EXPLORATORY: no external oracle exists for k-uniform polyform tilings, so counts are observations.
